summary.text: Tina Spears is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 36 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tina Spears lives in Charlestown, Rhode Island.
She earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Rhode Island.
Her career experience includes working as the executive director of the Community Provider Network of Rhode Island.
